main.description: An owner-defined role for one club, written in the club owner's repo inside the club space. The record key is a TID, so a name is ordinary data that may change; renaming is still create-new plus delete-old so every assignment keeps pointing at a record that exists. The three built-ins (Owner, Moderator, Member) exist without a record; `Owner` can never have one.

name.description: Display name. Immutable for the life of the record.

permissions.description: Permission keys from the app's catalogue. An unknown key grants nothing; an owner-only key is refused at the API.

rank.description: Ordering for management: an actor may only act on a target of strictly lower rank. 100 is the owner's alone.
